o1: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity; predicted to enable RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in defense response to bacterium; determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of macromolecule biosynthetic process; and autophagy. Acts upstream of or within positive regulation of plasma membrane repair; positive regulation of xenophagy; and response to oxidative stress. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in the intestine; anal depressor muscle; nervous system; rectal valve cell; reproductive system; and somatic cell. Is part of the autophagy pathway. Predicted to interact with linc-50. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Tietz syndrome; Tietze's syndrome; Waardenburg syndrome (multiple); familial melanoma; and renal cell carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including TFEC (transcription factor EC) and TFE3 (transcription factor binding to IGHM enhancer 3).
